symbols.label: COO_CANON_BACKEND
symbols.description: Canonicalization backend flag selecting the COO (coordinate) sparse-matrix format.

symbols.label: CPP_CANON_BACKEND
symbols.description: Canonicalization backend flag selecting the C++ (cvxcore) implementation.

symbols.label: EXP_ATOMS
symbols.description: Frozenset of atom names with exponential (DGP) semantics used by DCP/DGP analysis.

symbols.label: GP_EXP_ATOMS
symbols.description: Frozenset of atom names allowed by the geometric-program (GP) exponential rules.

symbols.label: GP_NONPOS_ATOMS
symbols.description: Frozenset of atom names allowed by the geometric-program (GP) nonpositive rules.

symbols.label: INFEASIBLE
symbols.description: Solver status string `infeasible`: the problem has no feasible point.

symbols.label: INFEASIBLE_INACCURATE
symbols.description: Solver status string `infeasible_inaccurate`: solver reports infeasibility with lower accuracy.

symbols.label: NONPOS_ATOMS
symbols.description: Frozenset of atom names whose arguments must be nonpositive for DCP analysis.

symbols.label: OPTIMAL
symbols.description: Solver status string `optimal`: the problem was solved to optimality.

symbols.label: OPTIMAL_INACCURATE
symbols.description: Solver status string `optimal_inaccurate`: an approximately optimal solution was found.

symbols.label: POWCONE_ATOMS
symbols.description: Frozenset of atom names involving power-cone (DGP) rules.

symbols.label: POWCONE_ND_ATOMS
symbols.description: Frozenset of atom names involving n-dimensional power-cone rules.

symbols.label: PSD_ATOMS
symbols.description: Frozenset of atom names whose values are positive semidefinite.

symbols.label: Pnorm
symbols.description: The vector p-norm, for p not equal to 1 or infinity.

symbols.label: Power
symbols.description: Elementwise power function :math:`f(x) = x^p`.

symbols.label: ROBUST_KKTSOLVER
symbols.description: Solver flag selecting the robust (QR-based) KKT solver used in canonicalization.

symbols.label: RUST_CANON_BACKEND
symbols.description: Canonicalization backend flag selecting the Rust implementation.

symbols.label: SCIPY_CANON_BACKEND
symbols.description: Canonicalization backend flag selecting the SciPy sparse implementation.

symbols.label: SOC_ATOMS
symbols.description: Frozenset of atom names representable by second-order cone constraints.

symbols.label: SOLVER_ERROR
symbols.description: Solver status string `solver_error`: the solver failed with an internal error.

symbols.label: Trace
symbols.description: The sum of the diagonal entries of a matrix.

symbols.label: UNBOUNDED
symbols.description: Solver status string `unbounded`: the problem is unbounded below (for minimization).

symbols.label: UNBOUNDED_INACCURATE
symbols.description: Solver status string `unbounded_inaccurate`: solver reports unboundedness with lower accuracy.

symbols.label: USER_LIMIT
symbols.description: Solver status string `user_limit`: a user-defined limit (time or iterations) was hit.

symbols.label: affine
symbols.description: Module `affine` — affine atoms: sum, concatenate, promote, and affine-combination helpers.

symbols.label: atom
symbols.description: Module `atom` — the abstract Atom base class and its DCP/DGP analysis machinery.

symbols.label: atoms
symbols.description: Module `atoms` — the library of atomic functions (norm, quad_form, ...) grouped by family.

symbols.label: axis_atom
symbols.description: Module `axis_atom` — base class for atoms that apply along a chosen axis.

symbols.label: constraints
symbols.description: Module `constraints` — constraint classes (Equality, Inequality, SOC, PSD, ...) used to build problems.

symbols.label: cvxcore
symbols.description: Module `cvxcore` — the C++ canonicalization core behind cvxpy's matrix-compression pipeline.

symbols.label: elementwise
symbols.description: Module `elementwise` — elementwise atoms (abs, power, exp, log, ...).

symbols.label: error
symbols.description: Module `error` — cvxpy exceptions (DCPError, DGPError, SolverError, ...).

symbols.label: errormsg
symbols.description: Module `errormsg` — helpers that generate solver error messages.

symbols.label: expressions
symbols.description: Module `expressions` — the expression-tree layer: constants, variables, parameters, and general expressions.

symbols.label: interface
symbols.description: Module `interface` — the matrix-interface layer abstracting numpy/scipy/sparse backends.

symbols.label: lin_ops
symbols.description: Module `lin_ops` — linear-operator primitives used during canonicalization.

symbols.label: logic
symbols.description: Module `logic` — logic-based atoms and constraints (indicator, implication, ...).

symbols.label: nlp
symbols.description: cvxpy.nlp — Namespace for NLP (nonlinear programming) atoms.

symbols.label: norm_nuc
symbols.description: Nuclear-norm atom: the sum of the singular values of a matrix expression; promotes low-rank solutions.

symbols.label: problems
symbols.description: Module `problems` — the Problem class, objectives, and the solve pipeline.

symbols.label: prod()
symbols.description: Multiply the entries of an expression.

symbols.label: reductions
symbols.description: Module `reductions` — solve-chain reductions: canonicalization, elimination, and solver compilation.

symbols.label: settings
symbols.description: Module `settings` — solver names, status strings, and canonicalization-backend constants.

symbols.label: stats
symbols.description: Namespace `stats` — cvxpy statistics helpers (benchmarking and solve diagnostics).

symbols.label: sum()
symbols.description: Sum the entries of an expression over a given axis.

symbols.label: suppfunc
symbols.description: Given a list of CVXPY Constraint objects :math:`\texttt{constraints}`.

symbols.label: total_variation
symbols.description: Total-variation atom: the sum of the magnitudes of adjacent-element differences; promotes piecewise-constant solutions.

symbols.label: transforms
symbols.description: Module `transforms` — problem transforms: linearize, partial_optimize, suppfunc, and indicator.

symbols.label: utilities
symbols.description: Module `utilities` — internal helpers: DCP/DGP utilities, settings, and plotting helpers.
